task.title: Repair deployment consumer owner credentials and truthful health

scope.owned_layer: Deployment outbox consumer authentication credentials (service token and tenant headers), scoped authority fetch origin verification, and truthful health reporting via successful/idle-success ticks and health file management.

composes_with.downstream: RuntimeBinding active state and paper fleet reconciler

normal_path_proof.mode: deterministic, isolated in-process consumer integration and authority contract tests
normal_path_proof.trigger: Outbox poll claim and event consumption with required service token, tenant headers, and truthful health ticks
event_sequence: Outbox claim and event consumption requests attach Authorization Bearer and X-Tenant-Id headers
Deployment authority validation checks exact origin matching before attaching deployment credentials
Successful and idle-success poll ticks atomically write truthful ok status with tick count and last_success timestamp
403 Forbidden or delivery failure marks status degraded, unlinks health file, and fails semantic healthcheck

acceptance.statement: Owner GET and mutation calls carry the required service identity and tenant.
Approved plan produces exact RuntimeBinding readback.
403 or zero-success streak marks consumer unhealthy, and successful/idle-success ticks determine health.
Scope authority verification credentials to exact deployment origin and reject foreign URLs.

safety.no_live_capital: pass; tests run against isolated mock endpoints and in-process fixtures with no live broker credentials.
safety.runtime_binding_write_owner: Runtime Manager remains the binding write authority; Deployment outbox consumer reads back active binding.
safety.credential_scoping: Bearer token and X-Tenant-Id are attached only to exact deployment owner origin requests.
safety.truthful_health: Health is driven by successful and idle-success ticks; failing and 403 ticks unlink the health file and mark the consumer degraded.

review.required_review: Independent exact-head review of credentials scoping, truthful health check, replay/readback tests, and evidence manifest.
